Unlock Digital Potential

Our Digital Experience Platform allows global brands to Orchestrate, Monetize and Experiment at scale.

  Digital Experience Platform

Conducting business online requires a modern combination of marketing and digital commerce to engage customers on all of your channels. Deliver the best experiences to your customers with a combination of creative content, product information, and campaign automation. The platform unifies the right application of content management, digital commerce, and customer intelligence to deliver customer centric experiences on every channel.

See documentation 

See skillset requirements 

  Content Marketing Platform

Optimizely Content Marketing Platform is a content marketing platforms (CMP), a marketing resource management (MRM), and a digital asset management (DAM), all in one! It provides seamless integrations into leading systems to become your central operating system — helping you get the most out of your existing tech stack.

See overview  

See features  

See documentation  

See user guide  

See roadmap  

  Content Management System

Optimizely Content Management System is a content management system and digital marketing suite. It uses artificial intelligence to deliver individualized content experiences across all of your channels.

See overview 

See documentation  

See user guide (PaaS) 

See user guide (SaaS) 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

See roadmap  

  Web Experimentation

Optimizely Web Experimentation is a testing and optimization application. Test and optimize customer experiences such as format and messaging, which provides customer data driven preferences.

See overview

See skillset requirements 

See roadmap  

  Feature Experimentation

Optimizely Feature Experimentation is the experimentation and optimization platform for development applications. This maximizes the performance and outcomes of an app, (rather than web experiences, like our Web Experimentation product).

See overview

See roadmap  

  Configured Commerce

Optimizely Configured Commerce (previously known as B2B Commerce) provides the flexibility required to manage the complex business rules and integration needs of enterprise business-to-business (B2B) and direct-to-consumer organizations.

See documentation

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

See roadmap  

  Commerce Connect

Optimizely Commerce Connect (previously known as Customized Commerce) is a complete digital commerce suite. It uses artificial intelligence, to deliver personalized experiences, individualized search rankings and product recommendations.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

See roadmap  

  Data Platform

Data-driven marketing teams use Data Platform to align their entire brand around the customer experience. Harmonize customer data across the Digital Experience Platform and the broader ecosystem. Gather a unified understanding of the customer context. Use powerful integrations to activate customer data with the right message at the right time during the customer journey.

Learn more  

See documentation  

See skillset requirements 

See roadmap  

  Connect Platform

The Optimizely Connect Platform (OCP) empowers developers to streamline data ingestion and channel activation by creating new connectors that integrate seamlessly with any marketing suite.  Developers can publish their connectors to our App Directory, and marketers can easily install and use the apps to compose digital experiences. OCP makes it easy for developers to connect customer data sources and any marketing suite together and provides marketers with single-click activations that simplifies their job significantly.

See overview  

See documentation  

See skillset requirements 

 

Recommendations

Provide best-next personalization at scale. Optimizely's Recommendations suite provides brands with a composable, always-on, predictive analytics engine to drive more revenue and deepen relationships. Custom-tailored to accelerate your business, the proper selection from Optimizely's 95+ personalization algorithms turn people's actions into actionable insights you can use to unlock continuous innovation at every step of the customer journey.

  Content Recommendations and Intelligence


Optimizely’s Content Intelligence automatically indexes, analyses and categorises your content to turn unstructured content into a valuable source of information to drive decisions. Natural Language Processing analyses your content in real-time to provide understanding about your content and how it is performing. Based on the data, Content Recommendations use artificial intelligence to personalize content recommendations across your digital channels. The solution selects content based on each individual's profile, interests and real-time behavior, and on the popularity of all content.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

  Product Recommendation


Product Recommendations uses artificial intelligence to personalize recommendations on websites. It analyzes every visitor, their individual customer journeys, and actions of similar customers, then presents real-time recommendations based on this data and your merchandising strategies.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

  Email Recommendation


Email Reommendations ensure that all emails are personalized for each recipient every time they open a message. The solution can also send personalized emails that are triggered by real-time behavior, such as abandoned baskets or browsed products.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

More enhancements

  Marketing Automation


Optimizely Marketing Automation is a suite of intelligent marketing products that help you create, manage and personalize campaigns across all of your channels. This includes web, mobile, email, text and social. The solution uses artificial intelligence and customer data to send and personalize content based on real-time behavior.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

  Search & Navigation


Optimizely Search & Navigation is an advanced, multilingual enterprise search solution. It allows users to search for terms found across all levels of your website, including documents, PDFs and other subsidiary websites. Optimizely Search & Navigation can also dynamically build landing pages based on user search terms.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

  Personalized Search & Navigation


Optimizely Personalized Search & Navigation is an enterprise search solution that personalizes content and product rankings in search results. The solution uses artificial intelligence to analyze a customer’s history, purchase history, real-time web browsing and email behavior to present relevant search results.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See forum  

See skillset requirements 

  Commerce Analytics


Commerce Analytics is an add-on module that provides additional insights to digital store performance, in addition to operational insights. Both the shopping behavior, (such as average order value, conversion performance), and your operations, (order fulfillment), are presented in dashboards for business users.

See user guide 

See skillset requirements 

  Product Information Management (PIM)


Product Information Management (PIM) is an add-on module to Commerce Cloud, that manages complex product dependencies and specifications for detailed product catalogues. With this natively connected PIM module, you can automate customer communications based on product updates and deliver more compelling experiences digitally with less effort from your staff.

See documentation  

See user guide 

See skillset requirements 

Community API


Optimizely Community API enables you to add User Generated Content to your digital channels, including ratings, reviews, and comments. The solution lets you store, manage and moderate this content.

See documentation  

See forum  

See skillset requirements
